description: Public abstract-level research taxonomy; categories do not certify full Methods or code reproduction.

domains.zh: 时序状态、记忆与动态计算
视觉、事件感知与空间智能
软件系统与高性能计算
计算神经科学与脑机接口
数据集、评测与可复现性

techniques.label: Adaptive firing threshold
techniques.definition: Threshold changes are part of the proposed neuron mechanism
techniques.exclude: Not optimization-time threshold scheduling for weight pruning

techniques.label: Dendritic compartment dynamics
techniques.definition: Explicitly modeled dendritic or compartmental membrane dynamics
techniques.exclude: Dendritic inspiration for ordinary weight pruning

techniques.label: Learnable membrane time constant
techniques.definition: The proposed neuron explicitly changes membrane state persistence
techniques.exclude: Generic membrane voltages in baseline descriptions

techniques.label: Resonant and oscillatory neuron
techniques.definition: Oscillatory/resonant neuron computation
techniques.exclude: Temporal cycles described only as an experimental effect

techniques.label: Neuron heterogeneity and homeostasis
techniques.definition: Heterogeneous cellular properties or explicit homeostatic control
techniques.exclude: Network heterogeneity only in datasets

techniques.label: Gated membrane state
techniques.definition: Gate modulates neuron state/update directly
techniques.exclude: Attention gates that do not alter neuron dynamics

techniques.label: Inhibitory neuron dynamics
techniques.definition: Inhibitory cell or synaptic spiking mechanism
techniques.exclude: Inhibition as a metaphor for loss regularization

techniques.label: Parallelizable neuron state updates
techniques.definition: Neuron evolution reformulated for parallel updates
techniques.exclude: Only a multi-GPU training implementation

techniques.label: Multilevel spike outputs
techniques.definition: Discrete event output has >2 levels
techniques.exclude: Weight quantization without multi-level spikes

techniques.label: ANN-to-SNN mapping procedure
techniques.definition: Mapping a pretrained ANN or related architecture into SNN computation
techniques.exclude: Training a native SNN from scratch

techniques.label: Conversion calibration and error correction
techniques.definition: A method directly corrects errors introduced by conversion
techniques.exclude: Generic performance comparison without conversion

techniques.label: Latency and TTFS coding
techniques.definition: Temporal or first-spike input/output representation
techniques.exclude: Network temporal processing absent an encoding design

techniques.label: Rate coding
techniques.definition: Frequency/rate maps information into spike sequences
techniques.exclude: Raw firing-rate reporting only

techniques.label: Phase coding
techniques.definition: Oscillatory phase used as explicit information code
techniques.exclude: Phase in signal analysis only

techniques.label: Input-to-spike encoding
techniques.definition: Input signal transformed into deliberate spike code
techniques.exclude: Camera data generated by a physical sensor

techniques.label: Surrogate-gradient estimator
techniques.definition: Method changes surrogate derivatives or their optimization
techniques.exclude: Merely using an off-the-shelf surrogate

techniques.label: Temporal credit assignment
techniques.definition: Addresses gradients across recurrent SNN time
techniques.exclude: GPU implementation without new differentiation logic

techniques.label: STDP and Hebbian synaptic update
techniques.definition: Hebbian/STDP-like synaptic update is part of the method
techniques.exclude: Biologically inspired wording without a learning rule

techniques.label: Local error and eligibility learning
techniques.definition: Uses local credit assignment or explicit eligibility signals
techniques.exclude: Standard BPTT over local neuron variables

techniques.label: Self-supervised learning objective
techniques.definition: A method defines a self/unsupervised training signal
techniques.exclude: Self-supervised labels only in an evaluation benchmark

techniques.label: Contrastive representation objective
techniques.definition: Explicit contrastive representation objective
techniques.exclude: Contrast with a baseline in results text

techniques.label: Knowledge distillation
techniques.definition: Teacher-to-student transfer of knowledge
techniques.exclude: Using a pretrained teacher merely as a feature extractor

techniques.label: Continual learning
techniques.definition: Preserve knowledge over a changing task sequence
techniques.exclude: Online samples without continual task shifts

techniques.label: Federated learning
techniques.definition: Client-data-separated collaborative training
techniques.exclude: Data parallel training on shared data

techniques.label: Online learning
techniques.definition: Incremental updates as streaming samples arrive
techniques.exclude: Online inference without online updates

techniques.label: Normalization for SNN optimization
techniques.definition: Novel normalization scheme as training contribution
techniques.exclude: Normalization used without method novelty

techniques.label: Training initialization
techniques.definition: Proposes trainable or algorithmic initialization
techniques.exclude: Initialization only listed among hyperparameters

techniques.label: Training regularization
techniques.definition: Regularization is the central optimization device
techniques.exclude: Generic mention of regularized training

techniques.label: Structured pruning and sparse training
techniques.definition: Methods prune structure or learn structural sparsity
techniques.exclude: Sparse activations only due to spike events

techniques.label: Zeroth-order and gradient-free optimization
techniques.definition: Optimizes without conventional model derivatives
techniques.exclude: Surrogate gradients are present

techniques.label: Spike-aware training losses
techniques.definition: Introduces a training objective specifically using spike dynamics
techniques.exclude: Task metrics reported as loss

techniques.label: Binary-weight optimization
techniques.definition: Weights or latent variables are trained under binary constraints
techniques.exclude: Binary spike outputs are normal SNN behavior

techniques.label: Progressive training schedule
techniques.definition: Explicitly schedules training stages
techniques.exclude: Multi-scale image encoding only

techniques.label: Data augmentation
techniques.definition: New augmentation operation affecting training samples
techniques.exclude: Augmentation only in baselines

techniques.label: Domain adaptation
techniques.definition: Transfer mechanism explicitly addresses domain mismatch
techniques.exclude: Domain as camera modalities, not shift

techniques.label: Spike-driven attention operator
techniques.definition: Novel attention operator or spike-native attention rule
techniques.exclude: Merely adopting a Transformer model

techniques.label: Spiking positional encoding
techniques.definition: Explicit positional mechanism for spike/token order
techniques.exclude: Attention mechanism with no new position encoding

techniques.label: Neural architecture search
techniques.definition: Search method discovers SNN network structures
techniques.exclude: Hand-engineered model architecture

techniques.label: Quantized computation architecture
techniques.definition: Computational architecture redesigned for quantized parameters/activations
techniques.exclude: Only quantization-aware training schedule

techniques.label: Multi-scale feature integration
techniques.definition: Explicit representation fusion/scale architecture
techniques.exclude: Generic multi-layer feature extractor

techniques.label: Token pruning and dynamic inference
techniques.definition: Model selectively avoids processing tokens/time/branches
techniques.exclude: Ordinary dense inference

techniques.label: Persistent recurrent state mechanism
techniques.definition: Learned or deliberately engineered recurrence/memory persistence
techniques.exclude: Ordinary LIF leaky state in baseline

techniques.label: Long-horizon and multi-timescale memory
techniques.definition: Method explicitly addresses long-horizon/multiple timescales
techniques.exclude: Dataset has long clips but no temporal mechanism

techniques.label: Temporal information regularization
techniques.definition: Explicit analysis/penalty of information in temporal states
techniques.exclude: Raw temporal metrics

techniques.label: Oscillatory sequence dynamics
techniques.definition: Explicit oscillatory/sequential dynamics
techniques.exclude: Speech rhythm as data only

techniques.label: Event-stream temporal aggregation
techniques.definition: Proposed aggregation/features for event streams
techniques.exclude: Simply taking event camera data as input

techniques.label: Spike-camera intensity recovery
techniques.definition: Method recovers intensity from physical spike sensor
techniques.exclude: SNN outputs spikes on conventional images

techniques.label: Neural 3D/4D rendering with spike supervision
techniques.definition: New neural rendering constraints/representations for 3D/4D sensing
techniques.exclude: Only downstream 3D task without rendering method

techniques.label: Motion-guided visual reconstruction
techniques.definition: Uses optical flow/motion estimation as reconstruction mechanism
techniques.exclude: Only evaluating motion perception

techniques.label: Spiking policy representation
techniques.definition: A policy/control learning mechanism with spiking representation
techniques.exclude: Robotic navigation as task only

techniques.label: GPU simulation and kernel scheduling
techniques.definition: Runtime or scheduling for accelerator-backed SNN execution
techniques.exclude: Time-parallel mathematical algorithm without runtime implementation

techniques.label: Activation-storage optimization
techniques.definition: Software method optimizes memory in execution
techniques.exclude: Only a gradient approximation algorithm

techniques.label: Edge and distributed partitioning
techniques.definition: Method partitions runtime across devices
techniques.exclude: Running all operations locally on an edge device

techniques.label: Integer-only inference kernel
techniques.definition: Integer-only software execution/inference pathway
techniques.exclude: Quantization trained only in network design

techniques.label: Temporal-parallel state execution
techniques.definition: Parallelization changes time-axis state computation
techniques.exclude: Only parallel GPUs without temporal algorithm

techniques.label: Memristive in-memory computing
techniques.definition: Implements compute/memory in a physical device/circuit
techniques.exclude: Software simulation of analog weight memories

techniques.label: Neuromorphic chip and accelerator circuits
techniques.definition: Novel chip/circuit or physical architecture
techniques.exclude: Just benchmarking an off-the-shelf GPU

techniques.label: Physical spiking neuron and synapse device
techniques.definition: Physical neuron/synaptic device mechanism
techniques.exclude: Theoretical LIF neuron with no hardware

techniques.label: Neural population dynamics model
techniques.definition: Models joint dynamics of biological neural populations
techniques.exclude: SNN population coding for AI classification

techniques.label: Brain-signal decoding model
techniques.definition: Decodes neural signals or maps them to outputs
techniques.exclude: Neuromorphic encoding of generic sensors

techniques.label: Biophysical circuit modeling
techniques.definition: Mechanistic biological neural circuit model
techniques.exclude: Generic architecture called biologically inspired

techniques.label: Cortical topographic organization
techniques.definition: Studies experimentally motivated cortical/sensory maps
techniques.exclude: Only visual classification benchmark

techniques.label: Latent biological spike process
techniques.definition: Latent statistical model of recorded biological spikes
techniques.exclude: SNN-generated spike features for machine perception

techniques.label: Adversarial attack mechanisms
techniques.definition: Threat or attack procedure is a contribution
techniques.exclude: Evaluation under attacks for defense only

techniques.label: Adversarial defense mechanisms
techniques.definition: Method counters attacks or certifies resilience
techniques.exclude: Only a paper proposing attacks

techniques.label: Dynamical stability analysis
techniques.definition: Theory or verification of state/gradient stability
techniques.exclude: Using stability as descriptive outcome only

techniques.label: Representation and receptive-field analysis
techniques.definition: Analyzes representation structure or information
techniques.exclude: Merely visualizes a feature map

techniques.label: Spiking combinatorial solver
techniques.definition: SNN-based search/optimization formulation
techniques.exclude: Optimizing SNN weights with SGD

techniques.label: Energy and quantization formal bounds
techniques.definition: Formal modeling of energy/precision behavior
techniques.exclude: Only measured runtime improvements
